reviews.text: Adorable shop! Came here to bathe my dog, since I couldn't do it outside due to the rain. The tubs were generously sized with steps leading up and a place to hitch your dog to. Warm water, blow dryer and towel were situated in the stall, along with brushes, ear cleaning accessories and paper towels. The staff were very friendly and welcoming. Shampoo provided sudded up nicely. Didn't have an appointment, I just walked in and there was no waiting. Pricing was reasonable. Would recommend!!
My babies came home smelling so good. I really appreciate the service that I received. I highly recommend..

First time I ever took my Baby to a groomer and it will be the last.  Worst experience.. my APPOINTMENT was at 2:30pm. I did not get my dog back until after 7 pm and my dog wasn’t finished.   I had to demand her back. They called me about someone else’s dog and when I went to pick my dog at 6, the time she was suppose be done. They brought me someone else’s dog.  Nothing but poor excuses. When I finally got my Baby back she looked awful.  Cut hair to short, discussed with the attendant before they started asked for a trim actually pointed to the Length on the chart and they shaved her nearly to the skin and messing not even a clean shave,  feet were trimmed messy my Baby’s face is so messed up and misshaped.  Complete disaster. Rude and unprofessional staff. Thank God hair grows back.
Tried to get a dog tag but was promptly turned away at the door for being closed (they in fact were open) and clearly just wanted to go home early

HORRIBLE service ! NEGLECTFUL employees with HORRIBLE communication. I was asked to bring my two dogs early for their appointments and waited 4 HOURS !!! Because they FORGOT my baby in the back kennels. His groomer LEFT EARLY without telling anyone and left my baby in the back the entire time unattended. I showed up 10 minutes before closing time because I hadn’t heard anything from the groomers and was told in a Joking matter how they forgot about him but would start his service at 6:00 PM WHEN I BROUGHT THEM IN AT 2:30 !!! They don’t answer emails or any type of communication. HORRIBLE HORRIBLE DO NOT COME HERE !!!!!

It's a bit pricey and honestly they had us in and out like we was a car wash. I honestly didn't feel like they took the time to clean my babies. The store is cute and they have a lot of beautiful items but it's a bit pricey. I rather stick to online buying if you ask me.
*On the plus note they do give military discount. But make sure to ask it will help a little save on taxes lol
Used the self service dog wash station and it was well stocked and the staff were super kind and helpful!
Great people. Great prices. I have a older Great Pyrenees. They always do a wonderful job.

My dog has been going to K 9 Cafe since she was just a puppy. They used to offer a “Puppy’s First Groom”.
It’s basically the mini groom. But, that was her first experience.
She’s almost 7 years old now.

I’ll admit that there was a dip in service for a couple of years post pandemic. But, things have returned to be more consistent.

I’ve taken her elsewhere. But, she and I are just more comfortable with K9 Cafe.
They made my boy jefe into a lady magnet 😂 the ladies in the store were fantastic he came out amazing I highly recommend.
Thank you! We appreciate your business and can't wait till we see you again.
When your dog walks out happy that is all that matters! Paisley literally thanked the entire staff. 🐾🐾🐾🐾 Yrish is the best and Desiree’s staff is awesome!
This is the place to go when you know your fur baby is in great hands. I and Mr. Ewok have no issues at all. They are the best ever! Thank you K9 Cafe!!!!

Fantastic selection of products. Went in to just kill some time and left with two dog outfits/a satchel carrier. Staff was incredibly helpful and kind. I believe the associate that helped us was named Darma (sorry if it’s wrong!) She showed us many different products, talked us through how they worked, and even helped us try them on our pup. Great experience and will be back! Thanks Darma!

We took our dog here for a hair cut and wash on May 10th for the first time because our regular groomer was closed and it was such a huge mistake. My dog came out of this place looking horrible and we found 4 fleas on him! We’ve been in self isolation so he hasn’t gone to a dog park or seen another animal in 2 months so we know for sure he got it from this place. The haircut was so unprofessional, the cut was uneven and he had streaks of the clippers they used around his neck and belly. I could’ve done a better job cutting his hair! They didn’t even cut his nails or his paw hair. They also did not give him a bath - he had some blood on his paw and his paws were dirty when he came home. We ended up washing him ourselves the same day. We paid so much money (over $90) for such a horrible haircut and for our dog to come home fleas (!) now we’re doing a flea treatment at home which is costing us even more money. We spoke with a worker at the store let them know our concerns about the fleas (I even took one of the fleas I had killed with me to show them) and were told that the manager was not there that day but that they would reach back out to us, we still haven’t heard back from anyone. We’re extremely dissatisfied and upset about their services and what’s even worse is that no one has done anything to address our concerns. I would never recommend this place to anyone. You’ll have much better luck taking your dog to a petsmart!

-Injury During Grooming and Lack of Accountability-

I am writing this review after giving the owner an opportunity to address a serious concern privately.

My dog was injured during a grooming appointment on December 23rd and was returned to me with two scratches that later formed scabs. I was never informed of any incident at pickup. I also noticed my dog was kept from noon until about 7 PM, which is significantly longer than usual.

When I reached out calmly and in detail to ask what happened, who groomed her, and why I wasn’t notified of the injury (I couldn't believe my regular groomer Trish hurt her, but the owner confirmed she served her that day) the owner’s response did not address the injury at all. Instead, I was told that “all groomers have their own style” and was offered a 25% discount for a future visit.

This is not a matter of grooming preference. It is a matter of safety and transparency. Offering a coupon without acknowledging or explaining how a pet was hurt is not professional and does not reassure a pet owner.

Because of the lack of accountability and clear communication, I no longer feel safe bringing my puppy back. I am sharing this so other pet owners can make an informed decision.
Super cute The staff isn't very attentive but you can always just go around the corner and get them everyone's super friendly but it is on the pricier side

I rescued a samoyed in early oct of this year and have had a horrible time with groomers. All have charged me between 250-325 dollars to groom her and have done a subpar job. Small details like shaving the paw pads, trimming the stomach or the private areas have gone amiss, and she usually came back to me damp with many tangles leftover. I saw K9 while I was picking up coffee for work and decided to give them a shot since I've yet to have luck elsewhere, and I am so glad I did. Not only are their prices reasonable, but she came out absolutely beautiful. It was the first time I've seen her coat so white, fluffy, clean, and tangle-free. The groomer even mentioned he gave her breaks when she got too hot in the dryer, which tells me they actually pay attention to their wellbeing during their service. I also noticed during drop off that the front desk lady took down notes during our consultation, many of the things she wrote verbatim to ensure she ended up with the proper haircut. If you are looking for a place to groom your furbaby, this is absolutely the place to do it.

Update: my 2 dogs are not the easiest to groom but they managed to give them cute haircuts before... now, its just not on par with before.. my dogs are always excited to go here though..

First time here when I brought in my 18-month-old shih tzu for a groom, and he came out so cute and smelling so good! Staff were friendly and paid attention to what my concerns were. I also know that my Kuma was in good hands because he didn't look stressed when I picked him up! I'm definitely recommending and coming back!

I am very nervous and anxious when it comes to taking my pets to groomers BUT I’m bringing mine back to K9cafe. I was all nervous and I walk in just to see how he is if he’s scared if he’s panicking if he’s crying . I walk in and he’s just all laid out getting groomed by Ms Trish. I’m all like OMG it’s been me all along Frankie was like oh hey mom ur here lol. He gets nervous going in but just I guess needs a min 🙂. Thank you all for the work you do.

My dog was left in the kennel per hours (7 hours total for a haircut is ridiculous) haircut was terrible even tho we showed them exactly what we wanted.
Staff is also very unprofessional,two groomers were literally yelling at each other as they were cutting some dog’s hair.
Terrible experience over all for the little amount of 80$ 🤮

I am writing a review only because the treatment I was given today by the lady at the front with her two dogs running around was dismissive and rude which was an abnormal interaction I usually have when coming here. I usually see the lady with short white hair and glasses and she is amazing and sweet. As a former Vet Tech I was appalled by how the front lady today (as stated before with the two small dogs with colorful tails) talked about her staff. A deaf groomer had cut my dog's nails and though she quicked one of her nails we did not ask to not pay or a deduction in price (but was offered anyways so for whoever is fighting in the reviwes with ex-customers you cannot use that in your defense for your behavior). The lady proceeded to blame the groomer's deafness for why my dog was extra stressed today, but in all honesty my dog was hyper stressed due to her small dogs barking at my dog the moment we came in. Her tone was dissmive as well when we mentioned that we have come here previously and had never had my dog this stressed or had her toe quicked before and I asked her to pull up who I had last time to 1) get the last groomer that did amazing & 2) show that it hasn't been that long of a time since her last groom so that she could not feign "neglect of an owner". I honestly don't think i'll come back only due to how unprofessional the owner is in the review section & how the lady with her two unbehaved dogs that bark and make the clients dogs anxious (I have my dog on file already from being here and I would expect when I come in with my dog's name that she was read she is an anxious dog that needs more attention to feel safe instead of parading her dog around and looking confused while also telling the techs to "not mess up" a groom because a lady tips well).

The groomers here seem to be great at their job, unfortunately the lady who works in the store area (owner?) leaves her dyed weiner dogs off leash that just constantly bark (yes I am aware you have signs stating they are off leash, but doesn't mean your dogs are well behaved at all). Our dog is already skiddish around people, but her dogs are constantly barking and running up to other pets which does not make the situation any easier. Pogo had an awesome cut and nail trim back in August by one of the groomers (forgot her name, but she was super sweet and Pogo actually behaved well with her). This time I had to hold my dog down and restrain her in order to get her nails trimmed, when during the late Spring I brought her in for a nail trim specifically and it took not even 5 minutes for them to take care of her. Not sure why I had to pay for a service and do half the work LMAO. Looking forward to the owner responding and belittling her clientelle for calling her out!
Very friendly and courteous good customer service

Grooming is excellent, customer service has it days. Never knew who was grooming my dog. I always wanted to compliment the groomer and hope I could stay with that groomer.  Sadly I had to leave. Look for another groomer.
Some nice and interesting accessories and supplies for your dogs.

We took our dog to K9 Cafe Boutique & Spa for grooming, and we had a great experience from start to finish. Our dog can be a bit of a fighter when it comes to getting his nails clipped and filed, but the staff were fantastic, super patient, understanding, and gentle with him the whole time. They never made us feel rushed or like he was a burden, which we really appreciated.
He came out looking and smelling amazing, and it was clear they took their time to do it right. You can tell they really care about the dogs they work with.
The prices were also a huge plus, way more reasonable than the big-name corporate places, and even more affordable than some local groomers we’ve tried in the past, even those who straight up refused to attempt nail services. On top of that, the boutique was well decorated, truly showing their devotion to pets, and well-stocked with fun treats and accessories.
We will be using K9 Cafe as our go-to location for our grooming needs! Highly recommend K9 Cafe to anyone looking for great service, fair prices, and people who truly love what they do.

I’ve taken my dog here multiple times, and I love the lady who grooms my dog, Trish, but my dog has come home twice now with a limp and whimpering. Granted my dog needed a lot of grooming this time around but I called to let them know because I was told if it happened again, to call and they’d ensure my baby got seen by a vet they work with. I called but no one called me back, I left a message with the owner. I did take my baby to the vet, got her on some meds for her limp but I dk if I’ll be coming back or not, Trish is great with my Shih Tzu but unfortunately this puts me in between a rock and hard place. Hard to find a trustworthy place for grooming and hard to send your baby back when they’ve come home hurt on multiple occasions. I don’t believe my baby was hurt on purpose, or that anyone did anything wrong to my dog but at the end of the day I didn’t send my dog with a limp. :(
They have a HUGE selection of pet clothes and awesome on-site grooming services!

Excellent place, the bathtub is super big, my dog was comfortable inside and it was easy for him to hop in and out. They provide all the products, towels dryer, drying table i totally recommend and I’ll be back every two weeks to groom my dog. They also offer grooming packages for the self service and the price is very reasonable.

When you pick up your dog, may you have a new dog, are magicians, however the waiting time sometimes is long takes about 3 to 5 or more time (I think this just happend on weekends)... They do not charge if you do not pick up your dog immediately, so that's perfect!! The results are incredible 🩵 …
Prompt on getting nails clipped
Took my dog to get groomed today and they did a very good job. I’m happy with this place.
My dog is so cute after she was done with the grooming!

Love this place a large variety for small dogs and a really lovely wash station so many cute outfits and bags. It’s so hard to find clothes for small dogs that are in arm and a leg. Everything is reasonably priced.

Alex Benitez is the only person who I will ever go to for grooming. I have a nearly 2 year old Goldendoodle and have had Alex as her groomer since her first groom. Alex always does an amazing job, and has great attention to detail. To top it all off, my dog loves him! 1000/10 would definitely recommend. P.S. the pink nail polish looks great!
Robyn groomed our cat and did an excellent job she was very intuitive! He looks great
They do such a good job and treat our furry family members so well!    My little girl was a rescue and was a matted mess when she came in!
My dog died doing what he loved

This was my 2nd experience of being lied to about the prices. I was quoted the same price twice before the work was done and given a whole different quote after the groom was completed. Very deceitful in their practice. Won't go back! Beware!!
Trish did an awesome job on both my babies! Love the service and shop will definitely be coming back!
Super fast, super friendly, walk in. It was a great price too!
My husband and I will always use this place. We have two german shepherds and a catahoula. They always do such a great job with them. We're so thankful and grateful for them!

Definitely recommend K9 Cafe for your fur babies .. after a few years taking our pup to petsmart they could never get what I wanted . Told our groomer Tricia what we wanted and our Gia came out looking like a movie star! Will be going back to her at K9 going forward.
Friendly staff, sweet atmosphere, lots of options.

I love K-9 Cafe and so do my girls. Ive been taking my 10 month old Yorkie to see Julez at the Braun location for about 4 months now and she does an amazing job with her. Yesterday I took my new baby Yorkie to see her for her first grooming she was so pretty when I picked her up she’s only 16 weeks old and starting them early is a must since they have their own minds of what they want to do. I am so thankful Julez is such a gem you can tell she loves what she does and she loves her little clients. Looking forward to a long relationship with her and my girls!!

Was a loyal customer for about a year but will not be returning. I was on my way to a grooming appointment when I got a flat tire. I was in the middle of changing my tire on the side of the road when I received a phone call from the groomer seeing where I was at. I apologized for the inconvenience and tried explaining the issue but she continuously was talking over me and angrily kept saying “You need to let us know.” I understand I was late for the appointment but I was doing everything I could to rectify the situation and asked to reschedule and was hung up on. I called back and asked to speak to someone else and they said they would take down my name and number and then hang up. To be clear they never took down my number. Then I walk in and all the owner did was blindly defend the groomer. And looking at other people’s reviews it seems the owner doesn’t like accountability based off the responses to legitimate grievances. If you can’t be respectful with me when I was being apologetic at first, I’m definitely not going to trust you to with my dog. Go to Kates up the street. They don’t disrespect their clientele and do just as good of a job. I’m very disappointed.
Such a great place self wash a large dog. They provided everything I needed for such a great price. And the customer service was amazing!
Love it, and they take great care of our elderly poodle 🐩 every time. …

This place is awesome! We get Mila groomed here, and also just found a new cute sweater for her during this chilly weather. 🤪
10/10 service ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ …

PLEASE SHARE!

Ordinarily, I do not report incidents concerning my animals. My priority is their well-being, which includes regular grooming services every 3-4 months. K-9 on Babcock has been my trusted provider of canine care for years. However, I am incensed by the unjustified $603.68 payment caused by their negligence. They offered only a cursory apology and a complimentary grooming. Did mentioned they dropped the ball. I will not return to this establishment. The nail removed was over a year old.  Shame on them, and shame on me for trusting. My poor Oreo!
